'''Alfred Hoblitzelle Clifford''' (July 11, 1908 – December 27, 1992) was an American mathematician born in St. Louis, Missouri who is  known for [[Clifford theory]] and for his work on [[semigroup]]s. He did his undergraduate studies at [[Yale University|Yale]] and his PhD at [[California Institute of Technology|Caltech]], and worked at [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology|MIT]], [[Johns Hopkins University|Johns Hopkins]] (as Associate Professor),<ref>{{Cite web |title=Alfred Hoblitzelle Clifford {{!}} tulane |url=https://sse.tulane.edu/math/library/clifford |access-date=2023-11-20 |website=sse.tulane.edu}}</ref> and later, in 1955, [[Tulane University]] (as Professor of Mathematics and Head of Sophie Newcomb College).<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Clifford Lectures {{!}} tulane |url=https://sse.tulane.edu/clifford-lectures |access-date=2023-11-20 |website=sse.tulane.edu}}</ref>

The Alfred H. Clifford Mathematics Research Library at [[Tulane University]] is named after him.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Alfred H. Clifford Mathematics Research Library | url=https://sse.tulane.edu/math/library | access-date=2023-12-19 | website=sse.tulane.edu}}</ref>

==Publications==
*Clifford, A. H. (1937), ''Representations Induced in an Invariant Subgroup'', Annals of Mathematics, 2nd series, 38(3): 533–550, [[doi:10.2307/1968599]], JSTOR 1968599, PMC 1076873, PMID 16588132
* George W. Mackie (1976), Theory of Unitary Group Representations, Chicago Mathematics Lecture, ISBN 0-226-50051-9
*{{Citation | last1=Clifford | first1=Alfred Hoblitzelle | author2-link=Gordon Preston | last2=Preston | first2=Gordon B. | title=The algebraic theory of semigroups. Vol. I | publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]] | location=Providence, R.I. | series=Mathematical Surveys, No. 7 | isbn=978-0-8218-0272-4 | mr=0132791 | year=1961}}
*Clifford, Alfred Hoblitzelle; Preston, Gordon B. (1967), ''The algebraic theory of semigroups. Vol. 2,'' American Mathematical Society
*Clifford, Alfred. H. (1974), ''The Partial Groupoid of Idempotents of a Regular Semigroup'', Tulane University, Department of Mathematics.
*Clifford, Alfred. H. (1974), ''The Fundamental Representation of a Regular Semigroup,'' Tulane University, Department of Mathematics.
*Clifford, Alfred. H. (1976), ''The Free Completely Regular Semigroup as a Set,'' Tulane Universite, Department of Mathematics.
*Clifford, Alfred Hoblitzelle; Edited by Hofmann, Karl H. & Mislove, Michael W. (1996), ''Semigroup Theory and its Applications'': ''Proceedings of the 1994 Conference Commemorating the Work of Alfried H. Clifford.'' Cambridge University Press, ISBN 978-0-521576697
